name: Feature Freedom
purpose: Give every Fleet feature an independent Off, Free or Paid state for every vessel.

authority_contract.owner: may view and request eligible paid upgrades
authority_contract.captain: may operationalize an already valid entitlement when delegated
authority_contract.admiral: sets each vessel feature Off, Free or Paid
authority_contract.browser: never grants entitlement from local UI state

security: No service-role or secret credential is present in browser code. Server-side entitlement writes remain protected.

state_separation.access: Off is stored as revoked; active access remains entitled or enabled.
state_separation.commercial: Active features are independently Free or Paid.
state_separation.environment: Sea Trial or Live is separate from access and price.

expansion: The same feature-level state model applies to every Fleet vessel without vessel-specific code.
